irrelevant_source: S01 classified-cartography solved workflow; zero relation-tag Jaccard for each selected target

gates.repeatability: The two raw assistant content strings for every condition must be byte-identical and system_fingerprint equal. Otherwise causal status is cannot determine.
gates.not_worse: DEFAULT and MATCHED both pass the same frozen task tests, and a blinded judge does not rank MATCHED below DEFAULT.
gates.different: Independent judge identifies a concrete MATCHED mechanism absent from DEFAULT.
gates.traceable: Independent judge maps that mechanism to a specific matched source relation and committed correspondence.
gates.reversion: With the source context removed under the same model/temperature/seed, output equals the repeatable DEFAULT result rather than retaining the matched-only mechanism.
gates.quality_confound: IRRELEVANT_WORKED is a correct solved source case with the same JSON shape/detail. It must not introduce the same distinctive mechanism or beat DEFAULT; otherwise classify example-quality/confounded and void a structural case.
gates.scramble: A correspondence map made by rotating target roles must be rejected by the deterministic signed-join validator before prompting.

existence_rule: At least one case satisfying repeatability, not_worse, different, traceable, reversion, quality_confound, and scramble establishes the tested system-level existence claim. Report all three denominators.
